amendment_reason: Independent probe identified six exact continuous candidate files. Presence is not causal eligibility; this amendment audits and quarantines them pending provenance proof.
decision_time_rule: M4 00:00Z timestamps are daily date markers, not availability instants. This lane freezes each cutoff at the SHFE day-session close, 15:00 Asia/Shanghai (07:00Z), so the completed daily signal bar may be visible without treating midnight as a completed session.

candidate_sources.claimed_timestamp_semantics: naive Asia/Shanghai period-end; generator linkage unverified
naive Asia/Shanghai period-end; generator linkage unverified

audit_findings: candidate Parquet metadata does not bind generator code, raw input identities, roll schedule, build cutoff, or query parameters
located continuous generator claims prior-session OI/volume selection and three-day confirmation, but linkage to candidate bytes is not proven
located regime generator uses a full-series ATR 80th percentile for stress labels, so that implementation is not prefix-causal

source_identity_pinning.basis: All six exact candidate byte streams are SHA-256 pinned and the audit rejects any mismatch without discovery or fallback.

strict_asof_aggregation_mechanics.basis: Tests prove filter-before-calendar-and-resample behavior and invariance to appended post-decision rows for deterministic D/W/60/15 candidate aggregation; semantic source eligibility remains quarantined.

underlying_ohlcv_asof.basis: Pinned au0/ag0 5-minute candidates cover all frozen decisions, but their bytes lack a bound generator/input manifest and their main_month annotations mostly change at calendar midnight inside a trading session.

roll_provenance.basis: main_month/is_roll are internally consistent, but no artifact manifest binds the source panel and causal schedule; calendar-midnight roll annotations prevent treating these columns as proven trading-day provenance.

delta_dte.basis: The bounded paired-trading input contract has no decision-time CN option delta series or exact exchange expiry calendar; percentage OTM and approximate expiry are prohibited proxies.

causal_iv.basis: Pinned option_ivskew rows cover all dates, but date-only labels do not prove same-day availability or bind maturity, chain, main-month, rate, raw option inputs, and build cutoff.

regime.basis: Pinned regime rows exist, but date-only availability and lineage are unproven; the located unbound generator uses a full-series ATR quantile, which is noncausal.

option_price_cadence.basis: The exact audited 5-minute files are underlying futures, not option premiums. No option intraday candidate is in the frozen exact source set.

dd_line.basis: There is neither a frozen DD-line definition nor bounded option intraday inputs in paired-trading; a percent stop or generic swing line would be an unapproved proxy.

bid_ask.basis: Current bar schemas contain OHLCV/turnover/open-interest but no historical bid or ask fields; costs are not imputed.

prohibited: future rows at a decision timestamp
candidate promotion, M7, trading, or execution
next_gate: Produce a generator manifest that binds each of the six pinned candidate hashes to immutable generator/source commits, exact raw-input hashes, query/build cutoff, timezone and period-end contract, and the causal prior-session roll schedule; repair main_month/is_roll to trading-date semantics and prove prefix invariance. Replace the regime full-sample ATR threshold with a declared expanding or trailing causal threshold, add explicit availability timestamps for IV/regime, and prove prefix invariance before promoting those inputs. D/W/60/15 aggregation mechanics need no new files, but remain quarantined from score_today until source provenance passes. Faithful Feitian still separately requires decision-time delta/exact DTE, option <=15min bars, a formal DD-line definition, and historical bid/ask.
